scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with clear limitations; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional across observed scope. Scores are subjective observations of these two assisted, paused emulated mobile attempts, not a win/loss grade or certification.

overall_mobile.reason: A cohesive, understandable short mission with strong touch assistance and clear recovery/coil progress. Crowded combat messaging and limited offscreen situational awareness reduce confidence. Completion alone does not establish quality, challenge, sustained enjoyment or unassisted control quality.

controls.reason: Large usable targets, tap aim, HOLD ROUTE and simultaneous route/FIRE worked. Manual movement and fine aiming remain unassessed; assistance does much navigation work.

gameplay.reason: Recovery, coil windows and upload gave a legible objective sequence. Shield pressure and armor windows were visible. Route holds carried much of traversal and recovery, so these runs provided limited evidence of deeper tactical engagement.

presentation.reason: Consistent teal typography and panels, wet station lighting, rain and copper coil silhouettes create a coherent atmosphere. Audio and hardware rendering quality unassessed.

usability.reason: Useful handbook, pause, planning map, progress feedback and reliable fresh start. USE/recovery terminology and overlapping contextual cues create avoidable friction.

readability.reason: Main objective, large health/ammo, route/recovery button and coil OFF states readable at 844x390. Small result-assist text, thin world signs, upper overlay occlusion and extraction/threat text overlap demand closer inspection.
